description: Queue a new demand-research run for an existing Explore lineage. May collect new provider evidence and consume credits. Requires the workspace, lineage and retry key. Returns run identifiers and execution state. Reuse the same idempotencyKey; supply confirmedScopeFingerprint only after requested scope confirmation.

body.description: Optional complete canonical refreshLineage body; explicit fields override it.

confirmedScopeFingerprint.description: Required only when a refresh admission rejected with EXPLORE_SCOPE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED; echo the rejected scopeFingerprint once after the principal confirms the aggregate scope, reusing the same idempotencyKey.

name: socialseal_explore_refresh
title: Refresh Explore demand
